paper: Eddies: Dynamical Action Tokens with Certified Composition (L4DC 2027)
layout: results/<experiment>/<file>. scripts/reproduce.sh regenerates every file listed here from the dataset episodes, except results/real (the Table 3 robot rows reported in the paper and the camera calibration). results/facts and results/eqoff are written by scripts/facts/; results/gate_margin holds summary.json, the per-step logs are in the dataset under derived/gate_margin/. Not listed: results/README.md

artefact_ids.text-1-contrib: Intro contribution numbers on the Eddies side: 4.3 cm tube, 275 of 400 finished at 5 cm; 77-100% vs 69-86% hand-overs at 5 cm
artefact_ids.text-4.1-eqoff: Sec. 4.1: equilibrium a median 0.2 cm from the command on the Franka; error to the command within the tube on 99.9% of test steps
artefact_ids.text-4.2-gains: After Theorem 1: 81 of the 85 certified Eddies of the ten tasks have a_i < 1 (also Fig. B.1 caption, Appendix B gains paragraph: ranges 0.64-0.85 / 0.86-0.92 / 0.84, four G1 Eddies up to 1.41, run factors <= 0.011 / 0.21 / 0.34 / 0.23)
artefact_ids.text-5.1-cert: Sec. 5.1 headline: tubes violated in 5 of 2,000 test episodes, 3-5 cm wide; envelopes missed in 6-16.5% (Franka) and 8.5-10.5% under the self-calibrating gate; 1,955 vs 890 of 2,000 finish at 5 cm; one-step check with fixed calibration finishes 1,968; at 2 cm 1,627 would leave mu and 97% are stopped first; at 3 cm 387 of 395 stopped and 1,328 finish; faster Eddies: 35-100% leave mu, gate refuses every plan
artefact_ids.text-5.2-tokens: Sec. 5.2: per-step envelope certifies no plan at these tolerances; with the reference model for every Eddie the tube is 1.5-7.6x wider
artefact_ids.text-5.3-transfer: Sec. 5.3: borrowed certificates violated or too wide; re-identified finish >80% (PhysX after ten training episodes); pulling the drawer 3.0 cm (Franka) vs 8.3 cm (G1), reaching for the peg 2.9-4.9 cm on all four
artefact_ids.text-5.4-newtasks: Sec. 5.4: new task finishes nearly every run with 1-5 false stops; conformal certificate finishes none without calibration and needs about 55 episodes to finish 83-93; push primitive certifies every staged-insertion Eddie and leaves nine primitives unchanged; LTLf product game recovers the four plans, runs five new goals (99-100%) and refuses three impossible ones; learned proposer 92-100% of hand-overs right, 99-100% nominal success
artefact_ids.text-5.5-real: Sec. 5.5: fixed-calibration gate stops 19 of 50 runs in Isaac Sim and 20 on the robot (9 and 7 once re-identified), self-calibrating 2-5; at 2-4x speed fixed-calibration gate catches every run, self-calibrating 95-99%; cube pushed out of the safe set -> certified stop holds 15 s
artefact_ids.text-A-ltl: Appendix A: product game recovers the four hand-written plans, solves five new goals (99-100% of 100 episodes each), refuses three impossible goals
artefact_ids.figB1: Fig. B.1 supp_gains.pdf: one-step gain a_i vs spectral radius, and the per-run factor, for every certified Eddie of the four robots
artefact_ids.tabB1: Table B.1: identification per robot: m, n, weights of M, S, reference Eddie

artefact_ids.tabD1: Table D.1: per-task certificates, 200 test episodes: Eddies, viol., tube median/p90, finished at 5 cm (fixed / self-calibrating), caught at 2 cm; totals 96 Eddies (85 certified), 5 viol., 890 / 1955, 1581 / 1627
artefact_ids.text-D-pooled: Appendix D pooled text: fixed calibration with only the next command checked finishes 1,968 of 2,000 (vs 890 / 1,955); at 3 cm 395 would leave mu, 387 stopped first, 1,328 finish

artefact_ids.tabD3: Table D.3: Franka certificates per Eddie vs per primitive: viol. (tube/chain), coverage, median chained bound, tightness
artefact_ids.text-D-certres: Appendix D coverage note: drawer coverage 0.835 (167/200) is within Beta(181,20) sampling (P=0.026 / 0.10); one quantile over the mixture of the four tasks (no per-task calibration; pool/mixture_{eddy,primitive}.json, printed by eddies.evaluate tableD3) is not valid per task: per-primitive coverage 0.965 / 0.970 / 0.960 / 0.680 (FMB / peg / stack / drawer), per-Eddie 0.910 / 0.965 / 0.870 / 0.825
artefact_ids.text-D-eqoff: Appendix D 'Equilibrium and command': offsets per robot, exceedance rates, O_i 0.10-1.91 cm
artefact_ids.text-D-learned: Appendix D 'A learned Eddie proposer': MLP (64,64) predicts 91.7% / 99.9% / 99.97% of held-out hand-overs on stacking / peg / staged; with the contract guard reproduces the supervisor on all 100 seeds; unguarded 99-100% nominal; behaviour-cloned commands: 16 of 100 successes, fixed-calibration gate catches all 27 that would leave mu
artefact_ids.text-D-tokens: Appendix D text on Table 1: per-step bound needs 4,769-22,499 calibration steps per task; Aero wheel certified at 10 cm (192 runs); splits; bootstrap +-10 runs; Eddies at 10 cm 359/174/340; the reference-model one-step error and the second Franka split are quoted from the paper
